Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
As a leading provider of software solutions for the healthcare sector, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment that is full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you will have the opportunity to make a lasting difference.
Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference – for a world where knowledge saves lives!
 Your Contribution
You take responsibility for the secure, high-performance, and modern operation of our Intune Endpoint landscape.
Together with the IT infrastructure and service team, you develop and implement innovative solutions for device management and privileged access.
You implement and maintain smart Enterprise Privilege Management solutions and ensure compliance requirements are met.
You actively contribute your ideas and expertise to exciting projects to further develop our IT infrastructure.
You ensure clear documentation, structured process descriptions, and knowledge transfer within the team and to the support function.
 What You Bring
Several years of relevant professional experience administering complex Windows endpoint environments; ideally, you already have experience with Linux clients or are motivated to develop further in this area.
5 years or more of experience in IT Engineering or successfully completed a degree in (business) informatics, or a related discipline.
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager.
Optional to have experience in Privileged Access Management (PAM). This Skill will be developed in the job;
We are enrolling Windows, MacOS, iOS and Android. In future Linux too. Experience with scripting and automation tools such as PowerShell is needed.
Bash and Python is an advantage and will be developed.
Fluent English, spoken and written. German is a plus.
Analytical thinking, strong service orientation, a self-directed working style, and strong team spirit round off your profile.
